preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page states usable for the Blazer EV 102 kWh pack. The Lyriq uses a 102 kWh gross / 100 kWh usable Ultium pack (Wikipedia; Auto-data 100.4), the same 102 kWh capacity and cells as the Blazer 102 kWh pack (InsideEVs Blazer table); ratio carried over.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Ultium 140Ah NMC pouch cells (EV Database, Lyriq-V); same Ultium cells in the Blazer EV 102 kWh pack (GM NCMA, closest enum nmc).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: the 102 kWh Ultium pack in the Lyriq is a 400-volt class pack (EVChargingStations); the Blazer EV 102 kWh pack is the same capacity and 190 kW peak. The Blazer 85 kWh pack is about 288 V nominal (InsideEVs).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs table (GM figures): RS RWD 102 kWh = 190 kW; up to 190 kW in GM launch material; EVChargingStations (2027 article): 102 kWh pack 190 kW (2026 SS). Years: 2025.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: 11.5 kW for the Blazer EV; Wikipedia 11.5 kW. Enel X Way (reseller) lists an optional 19.2 kW on RS RWD and SS and GMAuthority shows 11.5 / 19 kW in one column; Recharged says 11.5 kW on all trims; no NRCan 19.2 kW Blazer. Recorded 11.5 kW; the conflict is unresolved.
